title: notholaena hirsuta var. glabra
intro: Notholaena hirsuta var. glabra, commonly known as woolly rock fern, is a variety of fern that belongs to the family Pteridaceae. It is used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce inflammation, improve immune function, and protect against oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Notholaena hirsuta var. glabra include its ability to calm and soothe the nervous system, which may help to alleviate stress and anxiety. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
